contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 1000.00 + 250.00 = 2,250.00 exactly, matching all THREE printed anchors (page subtotal, schedule total, cover Column A line 1) plus the 2,250.- the filer re-copies at summary line 4 and again at line 5. The unique closure also validates the whitelisted dash-in-the-cents normalization this module already applies ('2,250.-' -> 2250.00): the three whole-dollar rows can only add to the printed subtotal if each trailing dash is read as .00, so the arithmetic, not a glyph judgement, settles it. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 2,250.- — identical because this is the filer's FIRST and ONLY report of the cycle (he withdrew), so period and year-to-date coincide; that is not a cumulative-exact case (§A6) and the PER-PERIOD Column A cell remains the anchor.

Handwritten in pencil. 4 pages (pdfinfo), all read full-page: p1 the 2014 blank cover; p2 the SUMMARY PAGE; p3 SCHEDULE A; p4 SCHEDULE B. ⚠⚠ THIS FILING IS A SECOND MIXED-TEMPLATE SPECIMEN, and together with dc0b5328 (Tracy, in this same chunk) it shows the wave brief attributed the property to the wrong filer. The brief says the mixed-template case is Ratcliffe (6d40e35d) — it is not; his schedules are the 2014 blanks. HERE the p1 cover is the 2014 blank while BOTH schedule sheets are the older pre-2014 template, and this filing carries the FULL tell described in the brief: p3 and p4 both head their third column 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' (the 2014 blank says 'Address, City & Zip'), and p4's SCHEDULE B REUSES SCHEDULE A'S PAYEE HEADING, printing 'Name of Contributor' over the vendor column instead of the 2014 blank's 'Purchased From/Source'. The grids also sit ~2.6 pct further right than the 2014 sheets in this chunk. Read the headings off each page, never from the cover year. FILER ANNOTATIONS: on p4 he hand-wrote '2014' ABOVE the printed 'Date' heading, which is a column-scope note about a year the cells themselves omit; every row date is nonetheless kept VERBATIM without a year and flagged needs_review=1, because only a row's own cell may supply that row's value (§C3) and the check-mark ruling (§B1) is the governing analogy — an annotation whose scope is not the cell does not fill the cell. MONEY NOTATION: this filer writes whole dollars with a DASH IN THE CENTS POSITION ('2,250.-', '1000.-', '251.-', '35.-', '100.-', '230.-', and '0.-' at summary line 3). That is the module's third whitelisted normalization, and here it is independently validated by unique arithmetic closure on both sides rather than accepted on its face. FOLIATION excludes the cover: summary 'Page 1 of 3', Schedule A '2 of 3', Schedule B '3 of 3'; the Last Name and Date of Report boxes are filled on the summary page and left EMPTY on both schedules — a partial-completion practice worth noting. THIRD-PARTY FIGURE OBSERVATION (§B5, a check and never a source): the Utah County Clerk candidate registration fee appears here as 569.48 for County Commission in 2014, against 682.19 for County Surveyor on the Ratcliffe filing in this same chunk and cycle, and 519.48 on two 2012 filings recorded by an earlier chunk — i.e. the fee is office- and cycle-specific and must never be used to corroborate one filing from another.
